title: POV: You're Making The Bed So Obviously I'm Helping
description:
You just fixed that. I un-fixed it. That's teamwork.

🧠 Understand the real behavior behind it: https://funnycutedogs.com/go/dogtraining

script: You smoothed out the blanket. I have seen this, and I cannot allow it. A flat, tidy bed is clearly unfinished, it needs texture, it needs a dent exactly in the middle, and it needs me standing directly on the pillow you just fluffed. You are calling this a mess. I am calling it collaboration. Every time you fix it, I will fix it again, because consistency matters to me. This isn't stubbornness for no reason either, there's a real instinct behind why dogs love flattening, digging, and rearranging soft surfaces, and once you understand it, the bed wars actually start making a lot more sense. The link's below.
hookText: You made the bed. I un-made it.
